programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Kelas dojo Johnny menarik sekelompok orang dengan karakter nan unik sementara putranya, Robby, yang memiliki motif tersembunyi, mendapatkan pekerjaan baru. Samantha mendapat teman baru di kelas sains.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Saat Johnny mengetahui Cobra Kai dilarang mengikuti Turnamen All Valley, ia menghadap Dewan Kota. Miguel mengajak Samantha berkencan. Robbie belajar dari Daniel saat teman-temannya berencana mencuri dari LaRusso Auto.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Johnny mempersiapkan murid-muridnya di Cobra Kai untuk mengikuti Turnamen Karate All Valley berikutnya dan ia pun terinspirasi untuk menata kembali hidupnya. Daniel masih belum mengetahui latar belakang murid barunya.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Tindakan sembrono Louie memaksa Johnny dan Daniel untuk mengenang masa lalu mereka. Murid-murid Cobra Kai merencanakan balas dendam terhadap anak-anak yang populer. Miguel merasa jengkel dengan Samantha.

programme.title: Cobra Kai
programme.desc: Hari penyelenggaraan Turnamen Karate All Valley 2018 dan Cobra Kai bertekad untuk menang. Robbie mendaftar tanpa afiliasi. Seseorang yang tak asing dari masa lalu hadir kembali.

programme.title: The Karate Kid

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Jared, Sam, Bryce, and Amanda, four divers, come across a sunken plane with cocaine while looking for a treasure chest. However, things get complicated when they try to sell it to a kingpin.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Peter, a former CIA officer, is assigned the task of protecting a valuable witness, Alice, who has secret information about a Russian presidential candidate.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: After his friend betrays him and disappears with the stolen goods, Sonny seeks vengeance. Subsequently, he partners up with a dangerous mob boss to achieve his goal.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam, a bike messenger, is wanted by the Chinese mafia and he is on the run while learning parkour after crashing into a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: A soldier and his brother escape into the woods when their city is invaded by North Korean paratroopers. After their father is killed, the brothers form a guerrilla group to fight back.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: Tensions escalate when a married couple, trying to balance their mundane lives while hiding their true professions, are hired to assassinate each other.

programme.title: Aliens in the Attic
programme.desc: While holidaying with their family, a group of children discover that their vacation home is riddled with aliens who intend to conquer Earth using a mind-control weapon.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Karen buys a high-tech doll named Chucky for her son, Andy, on his birthday. However, horrific events follow as the doll reveals its ominous tendencies.

programme.title: X2
programme.desc: William Stryker, an anti-mutant colonel, captures Professor Xavier in a special operation against him. Meanwhile, the rest of the students team up with Magneto in order to retrieve him back.

programme.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
programme.desc: A young woman who is abandoned by her family and grows in the marshland, is doubted for the murder of a man she shared a past with.

programme.title: Shanghai Noon
programme.desc: Chon Wang sets out to find Princess Pei-Pei after she escapes to the United States. He soon meets a gangster who, tempted by the ransom, agrees to help him on his mission.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.
